page.overview:
What is Shuttle S257?

Shuttle S257 was a Sentinel-class landing craft of the Galactic Empire's naval forces. the shuttle was stolen by the rebels of Phoenix Cell, where it was used by Kanan Jarrus and Rex in their mission to an experimental Interdictor-class heavy cruiser in order to rescue Jarrus' Padawan, Ezra Bridger, and Commander Jun Sato.

A Sentinel-class landing craft, Shuttle S257 was equipped with a hyperdrive generator and communications system which was compatible with the communications of an Interdictor-class heavy cruiser. The shuttle also came armed with its own weapon systems near its forward ramp and along its articulated wings.
